blocks.orig: The Rundugai Springs are a small oasis in the heart of a dry and dusty landscape, in between Arusha and Moshi. Locals call this wonder the ‘Chemka Maji Moto’ meaning ‘boil hot water’, refering to the way the bubbling water emerges from underground. Dive into this lovely, crystal-clear water with its awe-inspiring blue colour and pleasant temperature, surrounded by tropical palm trees and the impressive roots of large fig trees.
blocks.html: In a dry, dusty landscape between Arusha and Moshi lie the Rundugai Springs, a small oasis. Local people know this wonder as ‘Chemka Maji Moto’, or ‘boil hot water’, a name that describes how the water bubbles up from below the ground. Jump into the lovely crystal-clear water, which has a wonderful blue colour and a pleasant temperature, with tropical palms and the impressive roots of big fig trees all around you.
